items.title: Stella Oliver Interview, 1959-04-22
items.q: Oh, yes. Yes, I knew him. Erskine Tate.

ctx.x: I have those records. I've heard them. They're beautiful. Beautiful music.

Well, they worked a long time together and things began to get bad again. Then Louie went over to the, what's the name of this, theater on, uh, State Street. State near 35th. Oh, the Vandome was that? Uh-huh. And then Dome. Louie went then over to play there. They sort of split. Joe didn't have much work and we went over there and he played. He played for a long time with, uh, I think it must have been, with, uh, Tate. Oh, yes. Yes, I knew him. Erskine Tate. Erskine Tate, right. And they played and it was quite a…
